aboutGame.title: What is MapleStory Classic World?
paragraphs: MapleStory Classic World is a nostalgic pre-Big Bang MMORPG that brings back the classic MapleStory experience: slower progression, party quests, exploration, trading, and the original Explorer classes. It is officially playable through the Nexon Launcher and Steam, with Founder's Access opening on October 6, 2026 and full launch on October 21, 2026.

Whether you are chasing your first job advancement, hunting classic bosses, or rebuilding your meso fortune in the free market, our wiki covers every system with detailed guides, data tables, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

items.question: What is MapleStory Classic World?
items.answer: MapleStory Classic World is a classic pre-Big Bang MMORPG experience from Nexon. It brings back the original Explorer classes, party quests, trading, exploration, and slower progression with modern quality-of-life improvements.

items.question: When does MapleStory Classic World release?
items.answer: Founder's Access opens on October 6, 2026, and the official launch is scheduled for October 21, 2026.

items.question: Which platforms support MapleStory Classic World?
items.answer: The game is officially playable through the Nexon Launcher and on Steam.

items.question: How many classic classes are there?
items.answer: The classic experience focuses on 4 core Explorer classes, each with distinct job advancement paths and playstyles.

items.question: Are there active codes?
items.answer: Use the Codes page for working codes, rewards, expiration notes, and redeem instructions. New codes are added as they are released.

bosses.overviewDescription: Complete guides for every classic boss encounter in MapleStory Classic World, from early field bosses to party raids with detailed drop tables and strategies.
bosses.body: Bosses in MapleStory Classic World are progression milestones and gear checks. Early field bosses such as Mushmom and Jr. Balrog teach you crowd control and positioning, while party bosses like Zakum and Papulatus require preparation, coordinated damage, and the right potions. Many bosses drop scrolls, equipment, and rare items that define the classic economy. Use the guides below to prepare your party, learn attack patterns, and farm efficiently.
